title: Question Purposeful Explanations
description: When noticing a purpose in random events: - Ask yourself: "Is there any actual evidence of intention or design here?" - Consider randomness: Some things happen by chance without any goal behind them. - Separate cause from purpose: Look for causal explanations rather than assuming intent. Example: A storm ruined plans? Don’t assume it “happened for a reason”—explore natural causes instead.
